notes: The public CSV intentionally excludes Solidity source code for repository-size and release-safety reasons.
Every row includes a contract address recovered from the original address-bearing data or Sourcify metadata.
code_hash is retained as an irreversible identifier for audit and deduplication.
Use scripts/materialize_dataset_from_addresses.py to rebuild code,label,explain CSVs for rows whose verified source is available by address.
